instruction: Configure VS Code to save all files automatically when the window loses focus and set auto save delay to 1000 milliseconds.

metadata.explanation: This task is very similar to the original task, configuring auto save settings but with different values: onFocusChange mode and 1000ms delay instead of afterDelay and 500ms. The evaluator uses check_json_settings to verify both settings.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly retrieves VS Code settings.json from the standard user config location (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Metric function (check_json_settings) correctly handles expected parameter when type='rule' by accessing expected['expected'] to get the actual settings dict
Complete coverage: Both required settings are verified - files.autoSave (onFocusChange) and files.autoSaveDelay (1000)
Expected values are semantically correct: 'onFocusChange' corresponds to 'save when window loses focus' and 1000 matches '1000 milliseconds'
Metric logic is sound: Uses sentinel pattern to distinguish missing keys from None values, returns 0.0 if any expected key-value is missing or mismatched, returns 1.0 only when all match
Edge cases handled properly: Returns 0.0 on file read errors or JSON parse errors, handles partial matches correctly

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
